task: Unified action value (V(a) = R(b_t) - E[R(b_{t+1})] - C(a)) rationality audit — small scale, leak-free
purpose: verify whether the deployable V_Bayes predicts realized risk reduction better than the existing heuristic scores
verify top-action regret vs the current policy
decide Go / Conditional Go / No-Go for entering a learned verification-worthiness phase
blocker_status: NO BLOCKER — a deployable VerifyOld answer distribution exists
blocker_resolution: VerifyOld re-ask distribution P(y'|b_t,VerifyOld(i)) = sum_state P(state|b_t,key_i) * P(y'|state, channel). P(state|b_t,key_i) is BeliefTracker.predictive_state_distribution(key_i) (deployable: state_beliefs updated by the original report, retaining the fixed latent state). P(y'|state, channel) is the full AnswerChannel with the frozen NONE-cue mode prior. Resolution uses SurprisalClarificationProtocol.resolve. No latent state / true disease / oracle correction is read.

data.train_optimism_note: train cases are in-distribution for model-full.json (fitted on train); any optimism is reported, not treated as formal performance

channels.belief_channel: full AnswerChannel() (default cue_priors, includes MISREPORTED at base rate)
channels.answer_prediction_channel: full AnswerChannel() — matches NumpyQuestionSelector's marginal_probability(..., CertaintyCue.NONE)
channels.rationale: matches run_reliability_aware_dialogue default tracker (full channel); includes misreport so AskNew answer space covers yes/no/unknown/uncertain/misreport

belief_state.definition: b_t(d) = P(D=d | H_t) — NOTE: the current BeliefTracker does NOT condition on K (retrieval); retrieval is a separate label-free signal, not part of the disease posterior
belief_state.tracker: BeliefTracker(model, full AnswerChannel()), no misreport_gate (matches run_reliability_aware_dialogue default)
belief_state.finding_to_report: docs/DECISION_SENSITIVE_ACTION_VALUE.md writes b_t = P(D|H_t,K), but the code implements P(D|H_t) only; K enters only retrieval-impact / joint-gate heuristics, not the posterior

risk.realized_value: V_real(a) = L_Brier(b_t,D*) - E_o[L_Brier(b_{t+1},D*)|a] - C(a); D* (true disease) used ONLY as eval label, never in deployable V_Bayes or action ranking

action_value.asknew: V_new(j) = R_Bayes(b_t) - sum_y P(y|b_t,AskNew(j)) R_Bayes(b_{t+1}^{j,y}) - C_new(j)
action_value.verifyold: V_verify(i) = R_Bayes(b_t) - sum_y' P(y'|b_t,VerifyOld(i)) R_Bayes(b_{t+1}^{i,y'}) - C_verify(i)
action_value.verifyold_answer_space: full observable (value, certainty): for each v in spec.values -> (v,CERTAIN),(v,UNCERTAIN); plus (UNKNOWN,NONE). Joint P((value,certainty)|state) via full channel rates + NONE-cue mode prior
action_value.verifyold_resolution: SurprisalClarificationProtocol.resolve(original, y'); resolved report replaces reports[i]; belief replay (BeliefTracker over initial_observations + reports)
action_value.verifyold_no_perfect_correction: re-ask may return the SAME wrong value (resolve keeps it); may return a different value (resolve -> UNKNOWN abstain); no oracle correction

costs.note: costs recomputed offline only; model not re-fitted per cost

state_sampling.early: first turn where both AskNew and VerifyOld candidates exist
state_sampling.late: last turn before stop, or approximately turn 9-12

actions_per_state.note: do NOT keep only the policy's final chosen action; AskNew and VerifyOld in the same state are directly comparable

expectation.deployable_V_Bayes: model explicit enumeration over the answer space (no sampling, no simulator)
expectation.realized_V_real: Monte Carlo rollout, n=8 per state-action, common random numbers (rollout seed independent of action key), fixed deterministic rollout seeds; report MC standard error
expectation.rollout_seed: blake2b(base_seed | case_id | noise | state_index | rollout_index), base_seed=3031
expectation.one_step_only: each rollout executes the candidate action once; no multi-step RL

comparison_scores_per_state_action: current heuristic verification utility = existing_verification_utility (VerifyOld only)
label_free_scores: scores 1-6 are label-free; V_real is the eval target only, never used to pick a deployable action

rationality_checks.rank_correlation: Spearman + Kendall tau + 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of each score vs V_real, reported separately for AskNew / VerifyOld / combined
rationality_checks.calibration: bin V_Bayes and check E[V_real | V_Bayes in bin] increases monotonically; V_Bayes>0 actions should have mean V_real>0; V_Bayes<0 usually not worth executing
rationality_checks.pairwise_selection: compare argmax(V_Bayes_new, V_Bayes_verify) vs argmax(V_real_new, V_real_verify); report accuracy, AskNew->VerifyOld miscount, VerifyOld->AskNew miscount, delta vs heuristic
rationality_checks.top_action_regret: Regret = max_a V_real(a) - V_real(argmax_a score(a)); for EIG / current heuristic / retrieval joint-gate / V_Bayes policies
rationality_checks.actual_risk_reduction: per-policy chosen action realized Brier reduction, NLL reduction, wrong->correct, correct->wrong, action cost, net realized return; case-level paired bootstrap
rationality_checks.counterexamples: high error-prob but V_real~0; high retrieval-impact but V_real~0; medium error-prob but high V_real; V_Bayes and V_real sign disagree; EIG picks AskNew but V_real favors VerifyOld; heuristic picks VerifyOld but V_real favors AskNew

go_requires: 2. V_Bayes correlation higher than current heuristic utility correlation
3. V_Bayes top-action regret lower than current policy
4. V_Bayes selected-action mean realized Brier return not lower than current policy
5. V_Bayes positive-value group realized return clearly higher than negative group
6. no latent-state leakage into deployable V_Bayes
go_no_go.conditional_go: correlation improves but action regret does not
go_no_go.no_go: V_Bayes correlates weakly with realized return, OR realized loss after chosen action is worse; then analyze: posterior miscalibration, channel miscalibration, one-step value insufficiency, RAG contamination of posterior, need for learned verification-worthiness

tests: 2. value negative when risk unchanged but cost present
3. VerifyOld does NOT assume perfect correction
4. expectation is a probability-weighted sum over answers
6. deployable value does not read true disease
7. rollout evaluation truth is isolated from the prediction path
8. AskNew / VerifyOld share the same risk unit
red_lines: no training of a final value model this phase
no modification of existing formal policy default behavior
no true disease / latent state used to compute deployable value
no LLM / dense retriever / SFT / RL
no repeatedly switching the risk formula based on results
train audit not treated as formal generalization result
no modification of preregistered success criteria
